mechanism: exact algebraic identity (n^2 mod 4) + product of three anticommuting Pauli-conditioned pi-rotations being scalar on every Fock level; dirty (arbitrary-state) local qubit, no ancilla

rule.name: kerr_half_pi_local_dirty_qubit_xyz_cr_triple
rule.idea: exp(-i theta n^2) for theta = +-(pi/2 + k pi), using only the qubit co-located with the mode (dirty, no ancilla). Exact identity: n^2 mod 4 = n mod 2, so exp(-i(pi/2)n^2) = R(pi/2) * G with G = (-1)^{n(n-1)/2}. G is realized as a product of three CR(pi) gates conjugated into mutually anticommuting Pauli bases (X, Y, Z) via single-qubit frame rotations that compose to the identity overall, so U = C_X C_Y C_Z is a scalar multiple of the identity on the qubit for every Fock level n (scalar +-1 or +-i depending on n mod 4), leaving the qubit state untouched. The residual R(phi) on the mode absorbs the pi/2 vs 3pi/2 branch (sign of sigma3 sigma2 sigma1) plus the k*pi integer multiple. theta < 0 handled by conjugating (negating) the whole gate sequence.
